Sitting Date:12-10-1955

POLICE FORCE (AMENDMENT) BILL

"to amend the Police Force Ordinance", presented by the Chief Secretary; read the First time; to be read a Second time on the next available sitting of Parliament, and to be printed.

POLICE FORCE (AMENDMENT) BILL

Order for Second Reading read.

The Chief Secretary (Mr X): Mr Speaker, Sir, I beg to move, "That the Bill be now read a Second time." This amends section 44 of the Police Force Ordinance.
